#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Usage: run_qemu.sh <ELF_PATH> <VLEN> [--cwd DIR] [--readconfig CFG] [--timeout N] [EXTRA_FLAGS...]
set -uo pipefail

ELF_PATH="${1:?Usage: run_qemu.sh <ELF_PATH> <VLEN> [--cwd DIR] [--readconfig CFG] [--timeout N] [EXTRA_FLAGS...]}"
VLEN="${2:?Usage: run_qemu.sh <ELF_PATH> <VLEN> [--cwd DIR] [--readconfig CFG] [--timeout N] [EXTRA_FLAGS...]}"
shift 2

CWD=""
# Default to AX45MPV config — enables all RISC-V (Zba/Zbb/Zbc/Zbs/Zfh/Zvfh/Zfbfmin/Zvfbfmin/Zvfbfwma)
# and Andes extensions (zvqmac/vdot/vl4/vsih/vpfh/bf16cvt/codense) plus AE350 SoC settings.
# Override with --readconfig or --no-readconfig to disable.

TMOUT=60
EXTRA_FLAGS=""
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
        --cwd)           CWD="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --readconfig)    READCONFIG="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --no-readconfig) READCONFIG=""; shift ;;
        --timeout)       TMOUT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        *)            EXTRA_FLAGS+=" $1"; shift ;;
    esac
done

QEMU=/local/nick/qemu_andes/build/qemu-system-riscv64
TRACE=/tmp/qemu_trace.log

QEMU_FLAGS="-M andes_ae350 -cpu andes-ax45mpv,vext_spec=v1.0,vlen=${VLEN} -nographic -semihosting -bios ${ELF_PATH}"
if [ -n "$READCONFIG" ]; then
    QEMU_FLAGS="-readconfig ${READCONFIG} ${QEMU_FLAGS}"
fi

if [ -n "$CWD" ]; then
    cd "$CWD"
fi

timeout "$TMOUT" strace -f -e trace=write -o "$TRACE" \
  $QEMU $QEMU_FLAGS $EXTRA_FLAGS \
  > /dev/null 2>&1
RC=$?

# Extract semihosting output (fd varies: commonly 1 or 9)

  | sed 's/^[0-9]* *write([0-9]*, "//; s/",.*//' \
  | sed 's/\\n/\n/g; s/\\t/\t/g; s/\\r//g'

if [ "$RC" -eq 124 ]; then
  echo "[TIMEOUT after 60s]" >&2
fi
exit $RC

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Run a riscv64 llama.cpp binary under Andes QEMU (user-mode).
#
# Usage:   ./run-rv64-qemu.sh <binary-name-or-path> [args...]
# Example: ./run-rv64-qemu.sh llama-bench -m model.gguf -p 8 -n 4 -r 1 -t 1
#
# Overridable via environment:
#   ANDES_ROOT  Andes SW release root
#   QEMU        Andes linux-user qemu-riscv64
#   SYSROOT     toolchain glibc sysroot (matches the xandes-built libc)
#   BIN_DIR     directory with the cross-built binaries and libggml*/libllama* .so
#   QEMU_CPU    QEMU cpu string; zfh/zvfh must be enabled explicitly:
#               andes-ax45mpv does not enable them by default and
#               ggml_cpu_fp32_to_fp16 (vfncvt.f.f.w) SIGILLs without zvfh
set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
ANDES_ROOT=${ANDES_ROOT:-/local/nick/SW_Release/build-ast542}
QEMU=${QEMU:-$ANDES_ROOT/build-qemu/linux/qemu-riscv64}
SYSROOT=${SYSROOT:-$ANDES_ROOT/build-toolchain/linux/nds64le-linux-glibc-v5d/sysroot}
BIN_DIR=${BIN_DIR:-$SCRIPT_DIR/build-rv64/bin}
QEMU_CPU=${QEMU_CPU:-andes-ax45mpv,vlen=512,zfh=true,zvfh=true}

if [ $# -lt 1 ]; then
    echo "usage: $0 <binary-name-or-path> [args...]" >&2
    exit 1
fi

BIN=$1
shift
[ -f "$BIN" ] || BIN=$BIN_DIR/$BIN

exec "$QEMU" \
    -L "$SYSROOT" \
    -E LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$BIN_DIR" \
    -cpu "$QEMU_CPU" \
    "$BIN" "$@"
